subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “A museum displayed an ancient shoe found in a dry cave.”?
options: A body had disappeared, but a moment of movement remained.
Students were surprised that such an ordinary object was in a museum.
Unlike a crown or sword, the shoe belonged to ordinary movement.
Ordinary things could become history when someone asked their stories.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「A body had disappeared, but a moment of movement remained.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Students were surprised that such an ordinary object was in a museum.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Unlike a crown or sword, the shoe belonged to ordinary movement.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Ordinary things could become history when someone asked their stories.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Unlike a crown or sword, the shoe belonged to ordinary movement.」，答案為「Unlike a crown or sword, the shoe belonged to ordinary movement.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Unlike a crown or sword, the shoe belonged to ordinary movement.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
